  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# 01 · Limpieza y filtrado del dataset (@AppleSupport)\n",
    "\n",
    "**Objetivo del notebook:** partir del CSV completo de *Customer Support on Twitter* (varias marcas, ~3 millones de tweets) y obtener un archivo limpio que contenga **solo** la conversación de @AppleSupport: lo que los clientes le escriben y lo que Apple responde.\n",
    "\n",
    "**Qué produce:** `data/processed/apple_support_filtrado.csv` y un resumen de conteos paso a paso (esos conteos van en la sección de *Resultados* de la tesis).\n",
    "\n",
    "**Estructura de carpetas esperada**\n",
    "```\n",
    "proyecto/\n",
    "├── data/raw/twcs.csv          # dataset original de Kaggle (no subir a GitHub)\n",
    "├── data/processed/            # salidas\n",
    "└── notebooks/                 # este notebook\n",
    "```"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 1. Importaciones y configuración\n",
    "Aquí se definen las rutas, el nombre de la cuenta a filtrar y el **diccionario `COLS`**, que traduce los nombres de columnas del CSV a nombres internos. Si tu CSV usa otros nombres, solo se cambia aquí y el resto del código funciona igual."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import re\n",
    "from pathlib import Path\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "\n",
    "RAW = Path(\"../data/raw/twcs.csv\")\n",
    "OUT = Path(\"../data/processed/apple_support_filtrado.csv\")\n",
    "BRAND = \"AppleSupport\"\n",
    "\n",
    "COLS = {\n",
    "    \"id\": \"tweet_id\",\n",
    "    \"autor\": \"author_id\",\n",
    "    \"entrante\": \"inbound\",                  # True = lo escribió un cliente\n",
    "    \"fecha\": \"created_at\",\n",
    "    \"texto\": \"text\",\n",
    "    \"responde_a\": \"in_response_to_tweet_id\",\n",
    "}\n",
    "OUT.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n",
    "conteo = {}   # aquí iremos guardando cuántos tweets quedan en cada paso"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 2. Carga del dataset\n",
    "Los identificadores de tweet son números de 18-19 dígitos; si pandas los lee como número pierde precisión. Por eso se cargan **como texto** (`dtype=str`)."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",

   ],
   "source": [
    "df = pd.read_csv(RAW, dtype={COLS[\"id\"]: str, COLS[\"responde_a\"]: str})\n",
    "conteo[\"total_original\"] = len(df)\n",
    "print(df.shape)\n",
    "df.head()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 3. Filtro de @AppleSupport\n",
    "Nos quedamos con dos grupos:\n",
    "\n",
    "1. **Respuestas de Apple:** `author_id == \"AppleSupport\"`.\n",
    "2. **Tweets de clientes dirigidos a Apple:** los que *mencionan* `@AppleSupport` **o** aquellos a los que Apple respondió (así no perdemos tweets que no incluyen la mención, por ejemplo, dentro de un hilo).\n",
    "\n",
    "`ids_respondidos` es el conjunto de tweets a los que Apple contestó; se obtiene de la columna \"responde a\" de las respuestas de Apple."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "rol\n",
       "cliente    126113\n",
       "apple      106860\n",
       "Name: count, dtype: int64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 3,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "es_apple = df[COLS[\"autor\"]] == BRAND\n",
    "ids_respondidos = set(df.loc[es_apple, COLS[\"responde_a\"]].dropna())\n",
    "menciona = df[COLS[\"texto\"]].str.contains(r\"@applesupport\", case=False, na=False)\n",
    "es_cliente = df[COLS[\"entrante\"]].astype(str).str.lower().eq(\"true\")\n",
    "\n",
    "filtro = es_apple | (es_cliente & (menciona | df[COLS[\"id\"]].isin(ids_respondidos)))\n",
    "df = df[filtro].copy()\n",
    "df[\"rol\"] = df[COLS[\"autor\"]].eq(BRAND).map({True: \"apple\", False: \"cliente\"})\n",
    "conteo[\"tras_filtro_apple\"] = len(df)\n",
    "df[\"rol\"].value_counts()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 4. Depuración\n",
    "Se eliminan: tweets duplicados (mismo `tweet_id`), textos vacíos, y filas cuya fecha no se pudo interpretar. Se ordena cronológicamente porque más adelante la detección de incidentes depende del tiempo.\n",
    "\n",
    "> `dayfirst=True` interpreta fechas como dd/mm/yyyy. Si ves muchas fechas inválidas en el conteo, revisa el formato de `created_at`."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stderr",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "C:\\Users\\julia\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\ipykernel_9736\\3216274395.py:8: UserWarning: Could not infer format, so each element will be parsed individually, falling back to `dateutil`. To ensure parsing is consistent and as-expected, please specify a format.\n",
      "  df[\"fecha\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[COLS[\"fecha\"]], errors=\"coerce\", dayfirst=True)\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=COLS[\"id\"])\n",
    "conteo[\"tras_quitar_duplicados\"] = len(df)\n",
    "\n",
    "df = df.dropna(subset=[COLS[\"texto\"]])\n",
    "df = df[df[COLS[\"texto\"]].str.strip().ne(\"\")]\n",
    "conteo[\"tras_quitar_vacios\"] = len(df)\n",
    "\n",
    "df[\"fecha\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[COLS[\"fecha\"]], errors=\"coerce\", dayfirst=True)\n",
    "conteo[\"fechas_invalidas\"] = int(df[\"fecha\"].isna().sum())\n",
    "df = df.dropna(subset=[\"fecha\"]).sort_values(\"fecha\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## 5. Normalización del texto\n",
    "Se crea `texto_limpio` (el original `text` se conserva intacto):\n",
    "- los enlaces se sustituyen por `<URL>`;\n",
    "- las menciones a otros usuarios por `@USER` (privacidad y menos ruido), salvo `@AppleSupport`;\n",
    "- se unifican apóstrofes y espacios.\n",
    "\n",
    "No se pasa a minúsculas ni se quitan emojis aquí: los modelos como BERTweet los aprovechan. Las reglas del siguiente notebook ya ignoran mayúsculas."
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/html": [

       "    </tr>\n",

       "      <td>cliente</td>\n",
       "      <td>@AppleSupport I ask for the app not for the se...</td>\n",

       "    </tr>\n",

       "      <td>I’d love to know why my phone has been nothing...</td>\n",

       "    </tr>\n",
       "  </tbody>\n",
       "</table>\n",
       "</div>"
      ],
      "text/plain": [
       "             rol                                               text  \\\n",
       "2117917  cliente  @AppleSupport there is no audio coming from my...   \n",
       "350510   cliente  @AppleSupport I ask for the app not for the se...   \n",
       "1538675  cliente  I’d love to know why my phone has been nothing...   \n",
       "2473399    apple  @745796 Hi there! Send us a DM and we'll be ha...   \n",
       "156864     apple  @160197 We're here to help. Send us a DM and w...   \n",
       "\n",
       "                                              texto_limpio  \n",
       "2117917  @AppleSupport there is no audio coming from my...  \n",
       "350510   @AppleSupport I ask for the app not for the se...  \n",
       "1538675  I'd love to know why my phone has been nothing...  \n",
       "2473399  @USER Hi there! Send us a DM and we'll be happ...  \n",
       "156864   @USER We're here to help. Send us a DM and we ...  "
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 5,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "def limpiar(t: str) -> str:\n",
    "    t = t.replace(\"’\", \"'\")\n",
    "    t = re.sub(r\"https?://\\S+\", \"<URL>\", t)\n",
    "    t = re.sub(r\"@\\w+\",\n",
    "               lambda m: m.group(0) if m.group(0).lower() == \"@applesupport\" else \"@USER\", t)\n",
    "    return re.sub(r\"\\s+\", \" \", t).strip()\n",
    "\n",
    "df[\"texto_limpio\"] = df[COLS[\"texto\"]].apply(limpiar)\n",
    "df[\"n_palabras\"] = df[\"texto_limpio\"].str.split().str.len()\n",
    "df[[\"rol\", \"text\", \"texto_limpio\"]].sample(5, random_state=1)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
